title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description:
Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.


Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation


Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
  • Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs.
  • Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required.
  • Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required.
  • Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
  • Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
  • Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
  • Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
  • Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
  • Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
  • Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
  • Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
  • Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
  • Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).
  • Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.g., SIMOPS, ALARP).
  • Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
  • Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
  • A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:

Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.

  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

Our Client, a major oil and gas engineering company in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Lead Telecoms Engineer with 20+ years of expertise to manage their telecommunications package delivery. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.


Important: This position is located in Singapore and will require relocation.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Responsible as the Lead Engineer for all telecommunications-related engineering activities.
  • Manage and take full responsible for the delivery of the TSI/Telecoms Package.
  • Develop Telecoms Systems Specifications, TSI Scope of Work, and Bill of Materials.
  • Prepare Telecoms systems block diagram sketches.
  • Review telecoms systems studies such as PAGA coverage study, radio coverage study, VSAT link calculation, fiber optic link budget, etc.
  • Prepare requisitions and perform technical bid evaluations of Telecoms Systems.
  • Perform telecoms power consumption, heat dissipation, and weight estimation.
  • Liaise with clients to resolve engineering comments and provide solutions.
  • Coordinate with other disciplines and contractors on systems interfaces.
  • Lead, manage, guide, and mentor the Telecom Team throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring high-quality engineering deliverables.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (Telecommunications).
  • Minimum of 20 years of experience in Telecoms Detailed Engineering in the Oil and Gas industry, with at least 8 years of experience in Telecoms Package management.
  • Offshore project experience is preferred
  • Knowledge of international regulations, codes, and standards affecting Telecoms Systems.
  • Knowledge of Telecoms studies and calculations.
  • Proficient in writing Telecoms specifications.
  • Team player who can interact effectively with colleagues from other disciplines, clients, and suppliers

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.

Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.

Compras e Gestão de Custos:

Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.

Controles Internos e Compliance:

Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.

Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria:

Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.

Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
  • Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
  • Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets).


Também é legal se você tiver:

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. title: Comandante A330
description:
O seu sonho é comandar uma carreira de sucesso diretamente da cabine? CheGOL a hora.

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuarem como Comandante.


Em seu plano de voo, está prevista uma atuação junto ao Time da Diretoria de Operações, alinhada à estratégia da Companhia e aos regulamentos vigentes, contribuindo para a evolução das nossas operações com os mais altos padrões de Segurança e consistência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Missão do Cargo


Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.


Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.


Autoridade


  • Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação;
  • Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis;
  • Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança;
  • Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo;
  • Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados;
  • Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem;
  • Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle;
  • Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário;
  • Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica.


Segurança Operacional


  • Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final;
  • Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento;
  • Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo;
  • Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos;
  • Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV.;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;
  • Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa.


Gestão da Tripulação


  • Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação;
  • Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo;
  • Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists;
  • Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.


Conformidade e Registros


  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;
  • Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais;
  • Assegurar os registros de ocorrências a bordo, incluindo eventos médicos, nascimentos e óbitos, conforme regulamentação aplicável;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental.


Cabine e Passageiros


  • Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação;
  • Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando;
  • Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência.


Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:


Formação


  • Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)
  • Experiência superior na função


Certificações Obrigatórias


  • Licença de Piloto de Linha Aérea (PLA);
  • Certificado de Habilitação Técnica (CHT) para o Airbus A330;
  • Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA) válido;
  • Passaporte brasileiro válido por mais de 6 (seis) meses;
  • Vistos americanos B1, B2 e D válidos.


Conhecimentos Técnicos


  • Regulamentação aeronáutica aplicável (RBAC 121 e CBA);
  • Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança Operacional (SGSO);
  • Procedimentos operacionais da aeronave A330;
  • Operação de aeronaves widebody e voos de longo curso.


Idiomas


  • Proficiência na língua inglesa (ICAO) 4 ou superior.


IMPORTANTE: o local de trabalho será definido após a aprovação no processo seletivo. É necessário possuir disponibilidade para mudança.


Informações adicionais


Um lugar para crescer, viver e explorar


Oferecemos remuneração e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado, incluindo assistência médica, programas de bem-estar, participação nos resultados e mais.


Além disso, um dos diferenciais de fazer parte do Grupo GOL é o Benefício Viagem. Aqui, nossos Colaboradores têm a oportunidade de explorar o Brasil e destinos internacionais, vivenciar novas culturas, criar memórias e ampliar suas experiências.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Legal Assistant

  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation

  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET/SQL)

This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

title: Key Account - O&G
description:
Key Account - O&G


Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira.

Estamos em busca de um Key Account na área de Óleo e Gás para liderar a relação estratégica e impulsionar o crescimento no segmento de Óleo & Gás, atuando como principal ponto focal da conta. Essa posição será responsável por influenciar demandas e editais, identificar oportunidades ao longo da cadeia técnica e conduzir vendas consultivas complexas de serviços TIC e/ou equipamentos de alto valor agregado. Sobre o Grupo Bureau Veritas

Fundado em 1828, somos líder mundial em serviços de testes laboratoriais, inspeção e certificação, possuímos mais de 74 mil funcionários em 1.400 escritórios e laboratórios ao redor do globo. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social. Há 190 anos nossa marca é sinônimo de integridade e confiança, em benefício dos negócios e das pessoas, contribuindo para transformar o mundo em que vivemos. Para saber um pouco mais acesse o site


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e sustentar conexões de alto nível com stakeholders estratégicos (áreas técnicas, suprimentos e liderança), fortalecendo o posicionamento institucional
  • Influenciar tecnicamente e comercialmente a construção de editais e demandas, a partir do entendimento das necessidades do cliente.
  • Mapear oportunidades dentro da cadeia de valor de O&G, com foco em serviços TIC (Teste, Inspeção e Certificação) e soluções técnicas associadas
  • Conduzir vendas consultivas complexas, envolvendo serviços e/ou equipamentos de alto valor agregado para aplicações em infraestrutura, embarcações e plataformas;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica na identificação de demandas técnicas críticas (ex.: integridade de ativos, corrosão, manutenção industrial), propondo soluções customizadas;
  • Gerenciar e expandir contas-chave (KAM), garantindo crescimento sustentável e aumento de participação dentro do cliente;
  • Desenvolver novas contas no segmento de Óleo & Gás, ampliando a presença da empresa no mercado e gerando novas frentes de receita
  • Coordenar internamente com equipes técnicas e operacionais para construção de propostas robustas e aderentes às exigências do cliente
  • Atuar com forte protagonismo na negociação de contratos complexos e de grande porte
  • Acompanhar tendências regulatórias, técnicas e comerciais do setor, incluindo conhecimento aplicado em SEMPS
  • Garantir o atingimento das metas comerciais, acompanhando indicadores de performance e pipeline de vendas


O que buscamos:

  • Experiência em posições comerciais no setor de TIC (Teste, Inspeção e Certificação), com forte atuação no segmento de Óleo & Gás;
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de contas estratégicas (KAM), com foco em O&A
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da cadeia técnica e de suprimentos, incluindo dinâmica de editais e processos comerciais
  • Vivência com venda de serviços técnicos e equipamentos para aplicações industriais, offshore, embarcações e plataformas
  • Background técnico, preferencialmente com formação em engenharia ou áreas correlatas
  • Familiaridade com normas, processos e sistemas aplicáveis ao setor (ex.: SEMPS)
  • Forte habilidade de influência, negociação e relacionamento em ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e com visão estratégica;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre áreas técnicas e executivas, com comunicação eficaz em múltiplos níveis;


O que nós podemos oferecer:

Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios.

Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, do Bureau Veritas Brasil, o(a) candidato(a) declara:

  • Estar em condições técnicas e operacionais, no que tange à ergonomia, estação de trabalho e velocidade de conexão internet para desempenhar, quando necessário, o trabalho remoto “home office”;
  • O Bureau Veritas está em conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack PL
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Encarregado de logística
description:
Dover Fueling Solutions (\"DFS\"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios ClearView, Fairbanks, ProGauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Holanda, Suécia, França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações, visite

Sumário:

Coordenar as atividades do setor de logística, distribuir e orientar os serviços do Almoxarifado e Revenda, abrangendo o recebimento e armazenamento de peças nacionais e importadas, garantindo a acuracidade do estoque e os devidos registros de movimentações, acompanhar as atividades de expedição de peças e produtos acabados para o mercado interno e exportação, controlar todo o fluxo do processo de armazenagem dos armazéns internos e externos, coordenar as atividades de separação, embalagem e envio de peças e produtos de automação e intercompany, e processos de reparos eletrônicos com o objetivo de garantir a reposição de peças em campo e buscar soluções para eventuais problemas que possam ocorrer.

Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de almoxarifado:

  • Supervisionar a contagem cíclica e acompanhar as devidas análises bem como, tratativas das divergências quando necessário.
  • Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
  • Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
  • Acompanhar as rotinas de recebimento e programar junto ao time de compras os recebimentos diários, a fim de adequar a capacidade de recebimento a demanda;
  • Garantir a gestão do fluxo de recebimento e armazenamento de materiais, garantindo acuracidade da conferência, movimentação física e sistêmica dos itens recebidos, e eliminar divergências de estoque e ajustes financeiros desnecessários;
  • Analisar junto ao time de Sourcing e Qualidade o melhor tipo de embalagem para os produtos recebidos a fim de garantir o melhor uso de espaço do armazém, facilitando assim a conferência, armazenagem e garantindo a conservação do produto durante o transporte e no armazém;
  • Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
  • Participar de reuniões com a área de planejamento referente a programação de produção dos pedidos de revenda e monitorar estoque/itens em almoxarifado de peças fora de linha;
  • Garantir a continuidade do programa 5S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.

Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de Revenda

  • Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
  • Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
  • Identificar necessidades prioritárias de expedição de produtos acabados, coordenar a movimentação, armazenamento e organização dos materiais a serem expedidos, e coordenar todo o fluxo de saldos de produtos acabados internamente e em armazéns externos.
  • Realizar interface / acompanhamento, controles e negociações de prazos com empresas de transporte/correios, bem como elaborar indicador de desempenho de performance de transportadoras;
  • Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
  • Acompanhar entrada de pedidos de revenda, automação e pedidos intercompany, garantindo o atendimento aos prazos estabelecidos, bem como controlar a base de dados e todas as informações pertinentes aos processos de expedição e logística reversa;
  • Garantir a continuidade do programa 5S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.

Conhecimentos especificos / Habilidades:

  • Conhecimentos em ERP (preferência Oracle);
  • Conhecimentos em Excel (preferência Avançado);
  • Conhecimentos em Armazenagem e Frete;
  • Habilidade de comunicação / Liderança, Planejamento e relacionamento Interpessoal.

Qualificações básicas / formação:

Ensino Médio completo ou Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia Produção, logística ou afins.

title: Analista de Governança Microsoft Pleno | Senior

Atuar como referência de governança e sustentação técnica (nível N3) para o ecossistema Microsoft, garantindo estabilidade, segurança, conformidade e controle de custos principalmente em Power Platform, SharePoint Online e Copilot Studio. A administração e governança desses produtos é centralizada nos centros de administração (Power Platform Admin Center etc.) e envolve proteger dados, controlar acessos e monitorar o que makers/usuários fazem.

Escopo de atuação

Microsoft (Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, M365/Entra, Copilot Studio)

Administração pontual / governança leve de plataformas de IA corporativa (Gemini Enterprise, OpenAI Enterprise, NotebookLM) (ex.: gestão de acessos, onboarding, padrões e controles básicos)

Requisitos

1) Administração e Sustentação da Plataforma (N3)

Administrar ambientes (criação, padronização, saneamento, controle de capacidade e permissões), garantindo operação estável e previsível.

Executar rotinas de manutenção, saneamento e ajustes técnicos (ex.: ambientes órfãos, owners, conectores, políticas, agentes e automações fora de padrão).

Definir e manter runbooks e procedimentos operacionais para incidentes recorrentes e auditorias.

2) Governança e Segurança (Power Platform + Copilot Studio + M365)

Implementar e operar políticas de governança: DLP, segmentação de conectores (Business/Non-Business), padrões de ambientes e critérios de publicação.

Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade).

3) Desenvolvimento e Troubleshooting (N3 Maker) — obrigatório

Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em:Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança).

Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model-driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas).

Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM).

4) Administração do Dataverse (capacidade, saúde e KPIs)

Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário).

Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.).

Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao CoE e relatórios operacionais.

5) Gestão de custos e sustentabilidade financeira

Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de:Power Apps / Power Automate

Copilot Studio (agentes)

  • Realizar e/ou atualizar mapeamento de dados pessoais.

  • Acompanhar a evolução legislativa e regulatória sobre privacidade, proteção de dados e tecnologia.

  • Participar de projetos de Avaliação de Maturidade em Privacidade.


FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS


Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.


No FTR, utilizamos o Direito como uma ferramenta para negócios e mitigação de riscos.


Com escritórios no RJ e SP, atuação full service e multidisciplinar (desde o consultivo ao contencioso), o FTR tem como um dos seus principais pilares a inovação constante e caracteriza-se por uma dinâmica de trabalho extremamente ágil, estrutura horizontal e acesso direto aos sócios, permitindo um crescimento profissional rápido, multidisciplinar e integrado.


Há anos, o FTR impulsiona e relaciona-se com diversas startups e empresas de inovação, para utilizar a inteligência dos dados em otimização de eficiência e mitigação de riscos de clientes.


Atualmente, FTR desenvolve projetos com IA, plataformas de analytics e programas de GRC para gestão, compliance, mitigação de riscos | fraudes. Vivemos a rotina de projetos e nossa equipe é multidisciplinar e ágil. Trazemos soluções aos clientes. Oferecemos inovação ao mercado. Somos inquietos por natureza. E sempre mantemos nosso lema de: essência, experiência e excelência.

Você não será um programador focado em sintaxe tradicional, mas um Vibecoder: um profissional que utiliza o poder do Claude Code e agentes de IA para construir, gerenciar e escalar serviços de dados reais na nuvem.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.

  • Health and wellness package.

Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

title: Cientista de dados
description:

Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
